_provenance.purpose: Part 10b: intraplate velocity used to reduce ETRF2000 coordinates to BGS2005's legal reference epoch (2005.0), per Инструкция № РД-02-20-12/2012 чл.20 + Приложение 6.
_provenance.source: EUREF Permanent Network (EPN) multi-year combined solution, official reference frame product
_provenance.conversion_method: ITRF2020 cartesian velocity converted to ETRF2000 (Eurasian-plate-fixed) velocity using EUREF Technical Note 1 (Altamimi & Collilieux, IGN, 4 March 2024 release) Table 4 ITRF2020-row rotation RATES and translation RATES (eq. 2): V_ETRF2000 = V_ITRF2020 - dT - dD*P + Ω×P, where Ω=(drx,dry,drz) are the Table 4 rotation rates converted from mas/yr to rad/yr, dT is the Table 4 translation rate (mm/yr), dD is the Table 4 scale rate (1e-9/yr), and P is SOFI's own ITRF2020 position vector.
_provenance.conversion_params_source: EUREF Technical Note 1, Table 4 (ITRF2020 row): dT1=0.1 dT2=0.0 dT3=-1.7 mm/yr, dD=0.11e-9/yr, dR1=0.081 dR2=0.490 dR3=-0.792 mas/yr
_provenance.checksum_note: No single-file checksum published by EPNCB for .VEL/.CRD (plain-text ASCII products, regenerated each GPS week under the same filename) - provenance is the dated URL + release name (C2415) above, not a content hash.
_provenance.cross_check: Horizontal magnitude (0.52 mm/yr) falls within the independently-published Bulgarian GNSS/EPN intraplate velocity range of 0.2-3.8 mm/yr (BULREF 1993/2003 campaigns; Vassileva 2013 and related Balkan geodynamics studies) used in docs/part10_bgs2005_report.md - consistent, though smaller than that report's unconfirmed ~2mm/yr SOFI-specific figure, which this file now supersedes as SOFI's own, directly-sourced, current EPN velocity.
